message.subject: Motor bracket HB – two-year award proposal
message.body:
Thank you for your quotation. We are comparing two bidders for 18,790 pieces annually over 24 months and invite your strongest commercial proposal.
We can allow a 42-day lead time rather than 21 days in exchange for a lower price: either EUR 14.75 per piece with payment in 14 days, or EUR 14.90 per piece with payment in 60 days; both packages have a 42-day lead time and retain the fixed DAP terms.
Please confirm which package you can support for the full two-year award.

message.subject: HB bracket – revised counterproposal
message.body:
